plugins.description: Modified edition of antigravity-context-viewer (v0.9.2-1, synced to upstream v0.9.2): full-feature Aux Pane Sidecar UI parity (Antigravity 2.34+ ready) & CDP topbar gauge — 4-row Bento & Skyline session workbench, Gemini 4 Neon & unified quota pool, Google AI Ultra 5x/20x detection, and cost analytics.
suggestedPrompts: 打开 Context Viewer 侧边面板 (sidecar://antigravity-context-viewer/live-loader/)
检查 Context Viewer 当前运行状态与 Antigravity 2.34+ 兼容情况
查看 Context Viewer 支持哪些上下文监控与界面增强模块

plugins.description: Native Antigravity edition of Matt Pocock's skills synced with upstream main, supporting Antigravity 2.34+/2.35+ run_workflow/swarm DAG orchestration, ConversationService tracking, and .agents/skills.json manifest management.
suggestedPrompts: 打开 Mattpocock Skills Studio 查看 .scratch 拓扑波次并生成 2.34+ 编排脚本
/ask-matt 帮我看看当前需求适合走哪条研发技能流
/implement-spec 按拓扑依赖波次并发执行当前 Spec 的所有票据并双轴审查

plugins.description: Visual MCP server manager for Antigravity 2.34+: inspect & test MCP Apps (ui://), live-reload host servers, configure global/workspace/plugin MCP servers, and auto-inject per-MCP prompts via hooks.
suggestedPrompts: 打开 MCP Manager 面板查看当前 MCP 服务与 MCP Apps 状态
帮我在 MCP Manager 中探测并测试目标 MCP 服务的工具或 ui:// 视图
检查当前工作区与插件 MCP 配置是否有协议、路径或变量问题并重载宿主状态
